title: fix(lint, service-automation): warn when a mapping's connectorSource.connector names no rest or openapi connector, and log a failed pull
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9TfjTSudogGJweENGQ63yHe)_

Fixes #31813

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os validate` / `os lint` / `os build` 现在会对 mapping 的 `connectorSource.connector` 给出警告(`mapping-connector-source-unknown`)，当它不是 provider 为 rest 或 openapi 的 `connectors[]` 项时;名字是数据源时直接说「这是数据源」。同步拉取失败时，每次在 warn 级别记一行日志，写明 mapping 名和原因。
- 为什么改：之前把同步指向错名字(比如数据源 `legacy_db`)时，校验和启动都说一切正常，之后每个定时周期都静默失败，只有去翻 `sys_job_run` 才能发现。
- 风险与回滚：只新增一条警告和一行日志，不改任何接受面，校验退出码不变;`sys_job_run` 的写法不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/lint/src/validate-mapping-connector-source.ts`(判定与严重级别依据)、`packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-pull.ts`(包一层 try/catch 打 warn 后原样抛出)、`packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts`(一行接线)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration test/validate-mapping-connector-source-unknown.test.ts`,预期 1 passed:指向数据源的 mapping 得到一条警告，指向已声明 rest 连接器的 mapping 没有。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

1. **`os validate` names the bad connector reference.** New `@objectstack/lint` rule `mapping-connector-source-unknown` (`validate-mapping-connector-source.ts`), wired as one member of the reference-integrity suite right after its mapping sibling `validateMappingTargetFields`, so `os validate`, `os lint` and `os build` all run it on the whole stack. A mapping's `connectorSource.connector` resolves when this stack, or a sibling package of the same artifact, declares a `connectors[]` entry of that name with provider `rest` or `openapi`. Otherwise one finding at `mappings[N].connectorSource.connector`, saying what the name is: a datasource, a connector of another provider, a provider-less catalog descriptor, or nothing (with the nearest declared rest/openapi name).
2. **Severity `warning`, following the nearest rule of the same class.** The same question (does a name resolve into a collection whose members can also come from outside this stack?) is asked by `capability-reference-unknown` and `ai-skill-tool-unresolved`, and both advise. The connector universe has that shape: the automation plugin materializes `connectors[]` from every loaded package and from connector rows a Studio publish stores after boot, and one package's lint sees neither. `mapping-target-field-unknown` gates, but its universe (the target object's fields) is closed inside the stack and it skips any object the stack does not define. A warning keeps the stack's exit code, so the accept set does not move and `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` stand as claimed.
3. **A failed pull logs one `warn` line.** `pullConnectorSource` now wraps its body: on any failure it logs `[Automation] connector pull of mapping "NAME" failed (REASON): MESSAGE` with `{ mapping, reason }` meta (`reason` is the `ConnectorPullError` discriminator, or `failed` for any other throw), then rethrows the same error. The job run's `error` is written exactly as before. `warn`, not `error`: nothing was written, so no durability claim is broken (AGENTS.md degradation log levels), and the caller still receives the failure.
4. New exports from `@objectstack/lint`: `validateMappingConnectorSources`, `MAPPING_CONNECTOR_SOURCE_UNKNOWN`, `CONNECTOR_SOURCE_PROVIDERS`, `MappingConnectorSourceFinding`; an `os explain mapping-connector-source-unknown` entry.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/validate-mapping-connector-source.test.ts` (new, 9 cases): datasource named as a datasource (warning, located); CONTROL rest and openapi connectors clean; another provider and a provider-less descriptor; an unknown name with "Did you mean"; a sibling package's connector resolves; no `connectorSource` / non-string connector judged nothing; the finding comes out of `validateReferenceIntegrity`; the provider pair; the explain entry.
- `packages/cli/test/validate-mapping-connector-source-unknown.test.ts` (new, integration tier, one spawn): `os validate --json` on a stack with a mapping naming the datasource `legacy_db` and a second naming the declared rest connector `crm_api`. Exactly one finding, at `mappings[0]`, saying it is a datasource; exit 0. A second case pins the lint rule's provider pair to the connector pull's (`CONNECTOR_SOURCE_PROVIDERS` == `CONNECTOR_PULL_PROVIDERS`, both from the package roots).
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-pull.test.ts` (3 cases appended): a mapping naming `legacy_db` logs one warn line with `{ mapping, reason: 'connector_not_registered' }` and the typed refusal still reaches the caller; an untyped throw is logged as `failed` and rethrown as it was; CONTROL a successful pull logs no warn line.
- Forced test change: `packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.test.ts` pins the suite roster in report order, so the new member's name is added after `validateMappingTargetFields`. No other existing test was changed.

<details><summary>Ablations (each red, then restored: blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

A1, the suite wiring, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts` (member made to return no findings behind a string marker), lint rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 4 built files:
- lint: `× runs inside the reference-integrity suite, which os validate dispatches` (expected length 1, got 0).
- cli: `× names the datasource, and passes the mapping naming a declared rest connector`. The ablated `os validate --json` answered `"valid":true` with no finding and exit 0, which is main's behaviour: the card's red reading.
- Restored, lint rebuilt, preflight `--absent`: marker absent from all 20 built files, tree clean.

A2, the warn line, on `packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-pull.ts` (the `deps.logger.warn(` call put behind an unset global):
- `× a mapping naming a datasource, not a connector: one warn line…` and `× a throw that is not a typed refusal is logged too…`; 2 failed, 24 passed.
- Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `CONNECTOR_SOURCE_PROVIDERS` in lint mirrors `CONNECTOR_PULL_PROVIDERS` in `@objectstack/service-automation`, which `@objectstack/lint` cannot import; `packages/cli`, which depends on both, holds them equal.
- The rule does not judge `connectorSource.action` against the connector's actions: a rest connector's action list is materialized at run time from `providerConfig`, which static lint cannot see.
- The `#21127` validate/lint test (`validate-lint-mapping-connector-source.test.ts`) declares no `crm_api` connector, so `os lint` on its fixture now also carries this warning. Its assertions filter on messages containing `connectorSource`, which this rule's message does not spell, and they stay green unchanged.

## Verification

- Tree: head `0031be1a`, a merge of `origin/main` (with #31810's fix, b287761e) into this branch, no rebase. The one conflict was `connector-pull.test.ts`, where both sides appended a describe at the end: main's blank-match-key block is kept byte-identical, followed by this branch's warn-line block. `connector-pull.ts` merged cleanly, and main's change sits inside `pullOnce`; this branch's diff against main in that file is only the wrapper.
- Gates on `0031be1a`: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 70, all 70 run with exit 0; `--ran` with exit codes reconciles 70 run, 0 NOT MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Package suites on `0031be1a` (rebuilt after the merge): `@objectstack/service-automation` test 267/267 files, 3500/3500 tests, typecheck 0; `@objectstack/lint` test 198/198 files, 8374/8374 tests, typecheck 0; `@objectstack/cli` unit project 406/406 files, 5791/5791 tests, typecheck 0; the two CLI integration files 2/2 files, 5/5 tests.
- Provider parity (seat review): the CLI file asserts `CONNECTOR_SOURCE_PROVIDERS` (lint) equals `CONNECTOR_PULL_PROVIDERS` (service-automation). Ablated by changing the pull's pair to `rest` plus a marker (rebuilt, marker in 2 built files): 1 failed, 1 passed. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, marker absent from 6/6 built files.
- Lint: none of the three packages has a `lint` script; the root eslint (`--no-inline-config`) over the changed `.ts` files exits 0.
- Dogfood: not run locally (no `!` in the title, no narrowing arm, no example stack authors `connectorSource`); the queue's Dogfood Regression Gate runs it.
